name: Last.fm
author: Chronicle Contributors
description: Fetches music metadata from Last.fm (biographies, album and track info, tags, listener and play counts, similar artists) and imports your own Last.fm play history. Requires a free Last.fm API key; history import also needs your Last.fm username.
fixMatchHint: Enter a Last.fm URL (https://www.last.fm/music/Radiohead) or a typed ID: artist:Radiohead · album:Radiohead/OK Computer · track:Radiohead/Karma Police

background_tasks.description: Looks up Last.fm metadata for newly imported artists, albums, and tracks that don't have it yet.
Re-downloads all Last.fm metadata to refresh listener counts, tags, and biographies.
